speaker: Daniel
text: As a young girl during the Nazi occupation of the Netherlands, Audrey Hepburn was aware of the brutality, death, and destruction of war. She was malnourished, as her family was bankrupted as a result of the invasion. One day, Audrey was grabbed off the street by the Nazis and placed in line to be sent to a work camp. When the guards glanced away she darted off, barely escaping, and huddled in a cold, foul basement full of rats.
